caption:
A simple act of reaching for onions in her own kitchen ended in tragedy.

A 25-year-old woman named Shahanaz Akter died after being bitten by a venomous snake in her kitchen in Noakhali's Begumganj upazila.

The incident occurred on Sunday afternoon in the village of Mirwarishpur. Shahanaz was preparing food when she reached for onions from a kitchen rack around 12:30 PM.

A venomous snake hiding in the rack bit her as she reached for the vegetables. Her family initially attempted local treatment before rushing her to Noakhali General Hospital.

According to Resident Medical Officer Rajib Ahmed Chowdhury, Shahanaz passed away while receiving treatment at the hospital around 4:30 PM.

The deceased was the wife of Zayed Hossain and a mother of two children.

Begumganj Police Station Officer-in-Charge Mohammad Shamsuzzaman confirmed the incident, noting that the family had not formally reported it to the police.
